_comment: Asserted name<->stamp map between repo migration files and the rows prod’s supabase_migrations.schema_migrations holds for them. MCP apply_migration stamps the ledger with the APPLY-TIME version and the descriptive name, so a file’s own version never appears in prod. Written only by `npm run ledger:record -- <file> <prodVersion>`, which refuses a mapping the live ledger does not confirm. Read by scripts/lib/migrations.mjs (db:preflight) and scripts/migration-gate.mjs: a mapped file counts as applied only while prod still holds that version. Never hand-edit. Evidence for each row lives in the transcript it names.
